_meta.description: High-resolution micro-step funnels for business scenarios

real_estate_investing.name: Real Estate Investing
real_estate_investing.description: Path from aspiring investor to owning 5+ rental units generating $5K/month cash flow
real_estate_investing.entry_point: Get interested in real estate through social media, books, or someone who owns rentals

stages.label: Learn to analyze deals (cap rate, cash-on-cash, NOI)
Actively look at properties and tour them
Make first offer on a property
Get rejected or outbid on first offers
Inspection and due diligence (20% deals fall through)
Close the deal (sign papers, get keys)
Survive year 1 as landlord without selling

sources: NAR 2024 Member Profile & Home Buyers Report
BiggerPockets 2024 State of RE Investing Survey

coaching_consulting.name: Coaching & Consulting Business
coaching_consulting.description: Turn professional expertise into a paid coaching/consulting business reaching $20K/month
coaching_consulting.entry_point: Have 5+ years of expertise in a field and realize others would pay for your knowledge

stages.label: Have deep expertise or experience in a field
Decide to monetize knowledge (stop trading time for salary)
Define specific offer (who you help, what outcome)
Set initial price ($500-2K for first package)
Get first free or discounted client
Deliver a measurable result for first client
Get a strong testimonial or case study
Create landing page or simple website
Book discovery calls (avg 2-5% response rate on cold)

crypto_investing.name: Crypto Investing Journey
crypto_investing.description: From hearing about crypto to surviving a full market cycle and (maybe) profiting
crypto_investing.entry_point: Hear about crypto from friends, social media, or news during a bull run

stages.label: Hear about crypto (usually during bull market hype)
Buy first crypto (usually BTC or ETH)
Hold through crash (vs sell at loss)
Portfolio recovers to break-even or profit
Actually take profit (sell some at a gain)
Be net profitable after full cycle

marketplace_platform.name: Two-Sided Marketplace
marketplace_platform.description: Build a two-sided marketplace from zero to $10K/month revenue and 1K active users
marketplace_platform.entry_point: Identify a supply-demand gap where buyers and sellers can't find each other efficiently

stages.label: Identify supply-demand gap in a market
Talk to 10+ potential users on both sides
Build MVP (even if it's a spreadsheet or WhatsApp group)
Handle first serious dispute or fraud
Raise funding or achieve sustainable bootstrapped growth

import_export.name: Import/Export Business
import_export.description: Start an Alibaba-to-local-market import business and reach $2K/month net profit
import_export.entry_point: Notice a product selling well locally that can be sourced cheaply from China

stages.label: Spot a product opportunity (price gap, trending item)
Research product and suppliers on Alibaba
Receive and evaluate samples (avg 15-20 day delivery)
Assess quality honestly (90% have issues first time)
Place first order ($500-2K typical)
stages.source: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Seller

stages.label: Wait for shipping (30-45 days sea, 7-15 days air)
Receive inventory and inspect full batch
List on marketplace or local channels
stages.source: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Seller

stages.label: Make first sale
stages.source: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Seller

stages.label: Calculate real margin after ALL costs (often 15-25% less than expected)
stages.source: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Seller

stages.label: Handle first returns and quality complaints
Scale to 100 units/month
stages.source: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Seller

stages.label: Find and launch second product
stages.source: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Seller

stages.label: Reach $5K/month revenue
stages.source: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Seller

stages.label: Reach $2K/month net profit
stages.source: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Seller

sources: Jungle Scout 2024 State of the Amazon Seller

venture_capital_path.name: Raise VC -> Build Startup -> Exit
venture_capital_path.description: Founder raises venture capital to build a high-growth startup targeting a large market. The Silicon Valley path — high reward, brutal odds.
venture_capital_path.entry_point: Decides to build a VC-backed startup

stages.label: Apply and get into accelerator (YC, Techstars)
Raise Series A ($5-15M)
stages.source: Crunchbase 2024 — only 20% of seed companies raise A

stages.label: Exit via IPO or acquisition
stages.source: CB Insights 2024 — only 1% of VC-backed startups IPO

stages.label: Reach $1B+ valuation (unicorn)
stages.source: CB Insights 2024 — 0.00006% of startups become unicorns

venture_capital_path.reality_check: 75% of VC-backed startups fail. 95% don't return investor capital. Only 1% achieve a successful exit (IPO or acquisition above invested capital). Median time to exit is 7 years.

angel_investing.name: Angel Investor -> Portfolio -> Returns
angel_investing.description: High-net-worth individual invests in early-stage startups as an angel investor. High risk, potentially massive returns.
angel_investing.entry_point: Decides to become an angel investor

stages.label: Qualify as accredited investor ($1M+ net worth or $200K+ income)
Experience first complete write-off
stages.source: ACA 2024 -- 50-70% of angel investments go to zero

stages.label: See first portfolio company raise at higher valuation
Experience first exit (acquisition of portfolio company)
stages.source: ACA 2024 -- avg time to exit 7-10 years

stages.label: Return initial invested capital from exits
stages.source: ACA 2024 -- 20% of angels return their capital

stages.label: Hit 10x+ return on a single investment

angel_investing.reality_check: 50-70% of angel investments go to zero. Average time to exit is 7-10 years. You need 20+ investments for diversification to work statistically. The median angel returns 1x (break even). Only 10% achieve 3x+.

instagram_business.name: Instagram Business -> Followers -> Revenue
instagram_business.description: Person builds an Instagram following and monetizes through brand deals, affiliate marketing, and product sales. Visual-first platform.

stages.label: Define content niche and visual style
Consistently use Reels for growth
stages.source: Later 2024 -- Reels get 2x reach vs posts

stages.label: Full-time income from Instagram
stages.source: Influencer Marketing Hub 2024 -- ~1% of creators earn full-time

instagram_business.reality_check: Instagram has 2B+ monthly users. Organic reach has declined 50% since 2020. Average engagement rate is 1.6%. Micro-influencers (10-50K) earn $100-500 per sponsored post. Only top 1% earn full-time income.

tax_preparation.name: Tax Preparation Business -> Clients -> Seasonal Income
tax_preparation.description: Person starts a tax preparation business. Seasonal but highly profitable during tax season. Can add year-round services.
tax_preparation.entry_point: Decides to become a tax preparer

stages.label: Get tax preparation certification (EA, CPA, or AFSP)

tax_preparation.reality_check: Tax season is 4 months. You need 300+ returns at $200+ each to make real money. H&R Block charges $150-300 per return. Competition from TurboTax and free filing options is growing. But small business and complex returns pay $500-2000+.

staffing_agency.name: Staffing Agency -> Placements -> Revenue
staffing_agency.description: Person starts a staffing/recruiting agency placing temporary or permanent employees. High revenue, relationship-driven, scalable.
staffing_agency.entry_point: Decides to start a staffing agency

stages.label: Choose staffing niche (IT, healthcare, light industrial, etc.)
Register business and get workers comp insurance
Set up payroll processing for temps
Start outreach to companies needing staff
Sign first client agreement
stages.source: ASA 2024 -- enterprise sales cycle is long

staffing_agency.reality_check: Staffing is a $200B industry but margins are thin (20-30% markup on bill rates). You're essentially running a payroll company. Cash flow is challenging — you pay workers weekly but clients pay in 30-60 days. Workers comp insurance is expensive.

daycare_business.name: Home Daycare -> Licensing -> Growth
daycare_business.description: Person starts a home-based daycare/childcare business. High demand, recession-proof, but heavily regulated. Can grow to center.
daycare_business.entry_point: Decides to start a home daycare

stages.label: Get daycare license/registration
stages.source: NACCRRA 2024 -- licensing varies by state, complex process

stages.label: Get CPR and first aid certification
Enroll first child
stages.source: NACCRRA 2024 -- high demand in most areas

stages.label: Open standalone daycare center
stages.source: NACCRRA 2024 -- requires significant capital and licensing

daycare_business.reality_check: Home daycare is one of the most recession-proof businesses — parents always need childcare. But it's emotionally and physically demanding. Ratios are strictly regulated (4-6 kids per adult). Average home daycare earns $25-40K/year.

trucking_business.name: Owner-Operator Trucking -> Routes -> Fleet
trucking_business.description: Person buys a truck and becomes an owner-operator in trucking. High earning potential but brutal lifestyle. Can scale to fleet.
trucking_business.entry_point: Gets CDL and decides to go owner-operator

stages.label: Drive for a company to gain experience
stages.source: ATRI 2024 -- most start as company drivers

stages.label: Get MC number and operating authority
Get commercial trucking insurance ($8-15K/year)
stages.source: ATRI 2024 -- insurance is expensive for new operators

stages.label: Net positive after all costs (fuel, maintenance, insurance)
Buy second truck and hire driver

trucking_business.reality_check: Average OO grosses $200K but nets only $50-80K after fuel (30%), maintenance (15%), insurance (8%), and truck payments (15%). Lifestyle is brutal — away from home 200+ days/year. 70% of new OOs fail within first 2 years.

saas_marketplace_app.name: Shopify/WordPress App -> Installs -> Revenue
saas_marketplace_app.description: Developer builds an app/plugin for a platform marketplace (Shopify App Store, WordPress plugins, Chrome extensions). Platform provides built-in distribution.
saas_marketplace_app.entry_point: Decides to build an app for a platform marketplace

stages.label: Submit to app store for review

saas_marketplace_app.reality_check: Shopify has 10,000+ apps. Most get fewer than 100 installs. Platform takes 15-30% commission. But platform distribution means zero CAC if you rank well. The best strategy: solve a specific, painful problem for a niche merchant type.

wedding_photography.name: Wedding Photography -> Bookings -> Premium
wedding_photography.description: Person specializes in wedding photography, builds portfolio, grows to premium pricing.
wedding_photography.reality_check: Average wedding photographer earns $44K/year. Competition is fierce. You're booked months in advance or not at all. Editing time is 30-50 hours per wedding.

pressure_washing.name: Pressure Washing Business -> Jobs -> Scale
pressure_washing.description: Person starts a pressure washing business for driveways, decks, and commercial properties. Low startup cost, high demand.
pressure_washing.entry_point: Buys pressure washer and starts business

stages.label: Learn soft wash and surface cleaning
Market with door hangers and Facebook
Complete first paid pressure washing job
Hire crew and run multiple trucks

pressure_washing.reality_check: Pressure washing is seasonal in northern climates. Equipment maintenance is constant. Chemical handling requires training. But margins are 60-70% and repeat business is strong.

real_estate_agent_path.name: Real Estate Agent -> Sales -> Top Producer
real_estate_agent_path.description: Person gets real estate license and builds a career as a real estate agent. Commission-based, high earning potential.
real_estate_agent_path.entry_point: Decides to become a real estate agent

stages.label: Join a brokerage (Keller Williams, RE/MAX, etc.)
Get first listing or buyer client
stages.source: NAR 2024 -- many new agents struggle to find clients

stages.label: Close first real estate transaction
stages.source: NAR 2024 -- avg time to first close 6 months

stages.label: Stay in real estate after year 1

real_estate_agent_path.reality_check: 87% of new agents fail within 5 years. Median agent income is $54K, but mean is much higher due to top earners. You're 100% commission with zero benefits. Marketing costs $500-2000/month. Average agent works 40-60 hours/week.

crypto_trading.name: Crypto Trading -> Strategy -> Wealth
crypto_trading.description: Person starts trading cryptocurrency. Extremely volatile, 24/7 markets, high leverage available. Most retail traders lose.

stages.label: Buy first crypto (usually BTC or ETH)
Hold through first bear market/crash
stages.source: Chainalysis 2024 -- most sell at losses during crashes

stages.label: Be net profitable after 3 years (vs just holding BTC)
Grow portfolio to 6 figures from trading profits

crypto_trading.reality_check: Crypto is a 24/7 market with extreme volatility. Most retail crypto traders underperform simply holding BTC. Leverage on crypto exchanges can be 100x+. Studies show 80% of crypto traders lose money.

restaurant_startup.name: Restaurant -> Operations -> Growth
restaurant_startup.description: Person opens a restaurant. One of the highest failure-rate businesses. High capital, thin margins, brutal hours.

stages.label: Secure financing ($100K-1M+)
stages.source: NRA 2024 -- restaurant loans are hard to get

restaurant_startup.reality_check: 60% of restaurants fail in year 1, 80% in 5 years. Average restaurant profit margin is 3-5%. Food cost is 28-35% of revenue. Labor is 25-35%. Owner works 80+ hours/week.

life_insurance_agent.name: Life Insurance Agent -> Sales -> Agency
life_insurance_agent.description: Person becomes a licensed life insurance agent. Commission-heavy, relationship-based, high earning potential if persistent.

stages.label: Close first policy
stages.source: LIMRA 2024 -- avg close rate 20-30% on appointments

stages.label: Build own agency with agents under you
Earn $500,000+ annual (top producer)
stages.source: LIMRA 2024 -- MDRT top of table level

life_insurance_agent.reality_check: 70% of new insurance agents quit within year 1. Average first-year agent earns $30K. But top agents earn $200K-500K+. Renewals create passive income over time. The first 3 years are brutal.

consulting_mgmt.name: Management Consulting -> Partners -> Scale
consulting_mgmt.description: Person builds a management consulting practice serving mid-market and enterprise clients. Higher ticket than solo consulting.

stages.label: Leverage corporate network for first engagement
Deliver first project with measurable impact
Win second engagement (from referral or repeat)

consulting_mgmt.reality_check: Management consulting is one of the highest-margin businesses (30-50% operating margin) but requires deep expertise and corporate credibility. Average boutique firm takes 3-5 years to reach $1M revenue.

saas_ai_tool.name: AI SaaS Tool -> Launch -> Growth
saas_ai_tool.description: Developer builds an AI-powered SaaS tool leveraging LLMs, computer vision, or machine learning. The 2024-2025 gold rush.
saas_ai_tool.entry_point: Decides to build an AI-powered SaaS product

stages.label: Build prototype using AI APIs (OpenAI, Claude)
Build MVP with core AI feature
Launch beta on Product Hunt / Twitter
Get first paying user
stages.source: a16z 2024 -- AI tool conversion is challenging

stages.label: Manage AI API costs vs revenue (unit economics)
stages.source: a16z 2024 -- AI costs can eat margins

stages.label: Survive competition from OpenAI/Google features
stages.source: a16z 2024 -- platform risk is highest concern

saas_ai_tool.reality_check: AI SaaS is the hottest space but also the most volatile. OpenAI or Google can ship your feature as a free update. AI API costs mean margins are 50-60%, not 80%+ like traditional SaaS. Most AI tools are 'thin wrappers' that lack defensibility.

vlog_travel.name: Travel Vlogger -> Audience -> Revenue
vlog_travel.description: Person starts travel vlogging, documenting experiences across platforms. Monetizes through sponsorships, affiliates, and content licensing.
vlog_travel.reality_check: Travel content creation requires constant travel spending. Most travel vloggers lose money for years. Only the top 1% earn enough to fund their travel through content. Competition is extreme in every popular destination.

window_cleaning.name: Window Cleaning Business -> Clients -> Growth
window_cleaning.description: Person starts a window cleaning business. Low startup, high margins, recurring revenue from commercial contracts.

stages.label: Complete first residential window cleaning job

window_cleaning.reality_check: Window cleaning has 70%+ margins but is seasonal and weather-dependent. Commercial contracts provide steady recurring revenue. Height work carries real risk. But it's one of the simplest businesses to start.

wholesale_distribution.name: Wholesale Distribution -> Accounts -> Scale
wholesale_distribution.description: Person starts a wholesale distribution business buying products at bulk prices and selling to retailers, restaurants, or businesses.
wholesale_distribution.reality_check: Wholesale margins are thin (15-25%) but volume makes up for it. Cash flow management is critical -- you buy before you sell. Inventory management and logistics are complex. Competition from direct-to-retailer models is growing.

dental_practice.name: Dental Practice -> Patients -> Growth
dental_practice.description: Dentist opens own practice. High revenue, high overhead, equipment-intensive.

stages.label: Create business plan for dental practice

dental_practice.reality_check: Average solo dental practice owner earns $200-400K but carries $200K+ in student debt and $300-700K in practice debt. Overhead is 65-70%. Insurance reimbursements are declining.

saas_vertical.name: Vertical SaaS -> Industry -> Dominance
saas_vertical.description: Builder creates SaaS specifically for one industry (dental, real estate, construction, etc.). Less competition, higher retention than horizontal SaaS.

stages.label: Deep research into industry pain points
Achieve <3% monthly churn
stages.source: Bessemer 2024 -- vertical SaaS has 2x better retention

saas_vertical.reality_check: Vertical SaaS has lower TAM but higher win rates, lower churn, and higher ARPU. Average vertical SaaS commands 2-3x higher multiples than horizontal. But finding the right vertical takes deep industry knowledge.

private_label_supplements.name: Supplement Brand -> Launch -> DTC Scale
private_label_supplements.description: Person starts a private label supplement brand. High margins, strong repeat purchase. Regulatory requirements.
private_label_supplements.entry_point: Decides to launch a supplement brand

stages.label: Develop formula and get lab tested
Launch subscription/auto-ship model
stages.source: NBJ 2024 -- subscriptions are key for supplements

private_label_supplements.reality_check: Supplement industry has 60-80% margins but marketing costs eat most of it. FDA regulations require compliant labeling. Amazon takes 15% + FBA fees. Customer acquisition costs are $30-100 per customer.

notary_signing_agent.name: Notary Signing Agent -> Signings -> Income
notary_signing_agent.description: Person becomes a notary public and loan signing agent. Side hustle that can become full-time. Works with mortgage closings.
notary_signing_agent.entry_point: Decides to become a notary signing agent

stages.label: Build direct relationships with title companies
stages.source: NNA 2024 -- direct pays more than signing services

stages.label: Add general notary work and RON

notary_signing_agent.reality_check: Signing agent income is tied to mortgage volume. When interest rates rise, refinance signings drop 80%. Average signing pays $75-150. You need 3-5 signings per day for full-time income. Late evening and weekend signings are common.

etsy_digital_products.name: Etsy Digital Products -> Passive Sales -> Scale
etsy_digital_products.description: Person sells digital products on Etsy (templates, planners, SVGs, printables). Zero inventory, zero shipping, high margins.
etsy_digital_products.entry_point: Decides to sell digital products on Etsy

stages.label: Choose digital product niche (planners, SVGs, templates)
Optimize SEO, tags, and descriptions
stages.source: Etsy 2024 -- SEO is critical for Etsy digital

stages.label: Make first digital product sale
stages.source: Etsy 2024 -- digital products have high competition

stages.label: Build truly passive $3K+/month (no new products needed)

etsy_digital_products.reality_check: Digital products on Etsy are the closest thing to passive income. Zero COGS, zero shipping. But competition is extreme. You need 100+ listings to get consistent traffic. Etsy takes 6.5% transaction fee + 3% payment processing.

hvac_business.name: HVAC Business -> Service Calls -> Scale
hvac_business.description: Technician starts own HVAC (heating, ventilation, air conditioning) business. High demand, high ticket, recurring service contracts.
hvac_business.entry_point: Licensed HVAC tech starts own company

stages.label: Register business, get insurance and bonds

hvac_business.reality_check: HVAC is one of the best trade businesses -- avg install is $5-15K, service calls $150-500. Seasonal peaks (summer AC, winter heating). Finding good technicians is the #1 growth constraint. Profit margins 20-30%.

mobile_car_mechanic.name: Mobile Mechanic -> Clients -> Shop
mobile_car_mechanic.description: Certified mechanic starts mobile mechanic service, going to customers for repairs. Lower overhead than shop, convenience-focused.
mobile_car_mechanic.reality_check: Mobile mechanics save on shop rent but can't do all repairs (no lift, limited tools). Weather affects work. Average mobile mechanic job is $200-500. Platform takes 20-30% commission. Going direct saves huge on commissions.
